items.question: Trong câu "Domain knowledge is understanding the business field the system serves: banking, insurance, logistics, healthcare, retail, manufacturing.", từ "domain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domain knowledge is understanding the business field the system serves: banking, insurance, logistics, healthcare, retail, manufacturing.", what does "domain" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an area of expertise or industry
items.explanation: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (danh từ): lĩnh vực chuyên môn. "Domain knowledge" = kiến thức nghiệp vụ về lĩnh vực mà hệ thống phục vụ.
items.explanationEn: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (noun): an area of expertise or industry. "Domain knowledge" is knowledge of the industry a system serves.

items.question: Trong câu "Domain knowledge is understanding the business field the system serves: banking, insurance, logistics, healthcare, retail, manufacturing.", từ "field" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domain knowledge is understanding the business field the system serves: banking, insurance, logistics, healthcare, retail, manufacturing.", what does "field" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an area of activity or work
a data entry in a form
items.explanation: field /fiːld/ (danh từ): ngành, lĩnh vực. "Business field" = lĩnh vực kinh doanh; "work in the field of X" = làm trong ngành X.
items.explanationEn: field /fiːld/ (noun): an area of activity or work. "Business field" means an industry; "work in the field of X" means working in industry X.

items.question: Trong câu "Domain knowledge takes years — and that is exactly why it determines your value.", từ "determine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domain knowledge takes years — and that is exactly why it determines your value.", what does "determine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (động từ): quyết định, định đoạt. "Determine the outcome/value" = quyết định kết quả/giá trị; cũng có nghĩa "xác định" (determine the cause).
items.explanationEn: determine /dɪˈtɜː.mɪn/ (verb): to decide or strongly affect. "Determine the outcome/value" means to decide it; it can also mean to find out (determine the cause).

items.question: Trong câu "a question a generalist does not know exists.", từ "generalist" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a question a generalist does not know exists.", what does "generalist" (noun) mean?
options: người biết rộng, không chuyên sâu
optionsEn: an expert in one narrow area
a person with broad, not deep, skills
items.explanation: generalist /ˈdʒen.ər.əl.ɪst/ (danh từ): người biết rộng, không chuyên sâu. Trái nghĩa với "specialist" (chuyên gia); generalist biết nhiều thứ nhưng không sâu.
items.explanationEn: generalist /ˈdʒen.ər.əl.ɪst/ (noun): a person with broad, not deep, skills. The opposite of "specialist"; a generalist knows many things but none deeply.

items.question: Trong câu "When a customer describes a process that deviates from the industry norm, you know to probe rather than transcribe.", từ "deviate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a customer describes a process that deviates from the industry norm, you know to probe rather than transcribe.", what does "deviate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move away from what is usual
items.explanation: deviate /ˈdiː.vi.eɪt/ (động từ): đi lệch khỏi. Thường đi với "from": "deviate from the plan/standard" = đi lệch khỏi kế hoạch/tiêu chuẩn.
items.explanationEn: deviate /ˈdiː.vi.eɪt/ (verb): to move away from what is usual. Usually used with "from": "deviate from the plan/standard".

items.question: Trong câu "When a customer describes a process that deviates from the industry norm, you know to probe rather than transcribe.", từ "norm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a customer describes a process that deviates from the industry norm, you know to probe rather than transcribe.", what does "norm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: norm /nɔːm/ (danh từ): chuẩn mực, thông lệ. "Industry norm" = thông lệ của ngành; "the norm" = điều bình thường, phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: norm /nɔːm/ (noun): the usual or expected standard. "Industry norm" is standard practice in an industry; "the norm" is what is normal.

items.question: Trong câu "When a customer describes a process that deviates from the industry norm, you know to probe rather than transcribe.", từ "probe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a customer describes a process that deviates from the industry norm, you know to probe rather than transcribe.", what does "probe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to ask questions to find out more
items.explanation: probe /prəʊb/ (động từ): hỏi sâu, thăm dò. "Probe into something" = điều tra, hỏi sâu vào điều gì; BA cần probe khi nghe điều bất thường.
items.explanationEn: probe /prəʊb/ (verb): to ask questions to find out more. "Probe into something" means to investigate it; a BA probes when something sounds unusual.

items.question: Trong câu "When a customer describes a process that deviates from the industry norm, you know to probe rather than transcribe.", từ "transcribe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a customer describes a process that deviates from the industry norm, you know to probe rather than transcribe.", what does "transcribe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to write down exactly what is said
items.explanation: transcribe /trænˈskraɪb/ (động từ): ghi chép lại nguyên văn. Ở đây ý là chỉ chép lại lời khách hàng mà không suy nghĩ; danh từ: transcript (bản ghi).
items.explanationEn: transcribe /trænˈskraɪb/ (verb): to write down exactly what is said. Here it means just writing down what the customer says without thinking; noun: transcript.

items.question: Trong câu "Business people open up to someone who understands their work and close down with someone who needs every term explained.", từ "open up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business people open up to someone who understands their work and close down with someone who needs every term explained.", what does "open up" (phrase) mean?
options: cởi mở, sẵn lòng chia sẻ
items.explanation: open up /ˈəʊ.pən ʌp/ (cụm từ): cởi mở, sẵn lòng chia sẻ. "Open up to someone" = cởi mở với ai; trái nghĩa trong câu là "close down" (khép kín lại).
items.explanationEn: open up /ˈəʊ.pən ʌp/ (phrase): to talk freely about thoughts. "Open up to someone" means to share freely with them; the contrast here is "close down".

items.question: Trong câu "This is also why career changers from accounting, banking, or healthcare have a genuine advantage.", từ "genuine" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is also why career changers from accounting, banking, or healthcare have a genuine advantage.", what does "genuine" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (tính từ): thực sự, đích thực. "A genuine advantage/interest" = lợi thế/sự quan tâm thật sự; cũng dùng cho hàng chính hãng.
items.explanationEn: genuine /ˈdʒen.ju.ɪn/ (adjective): real and not pretended. "A genuine advantage/interest" is a real one; also used for authentic goods.

items.question: Trong câu "This is also why career changers from accounting, banking, or healthcare have a genuine advantage.", từ "career changer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is also why career changers from accounting, banking, or healthcare have a genuine advantage.", what does "career changer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: someone moving to a new profession
items.explanation: career changer /kəˈrɪə ˌtʃeɪn.dʒər/ (danh từ): người chuyển ngành. Động từ tương ứng: "change careers" = đổi nghề, chuyển ngành.
items.explanationEn: career changer /kəˈrɪə ˌtʃeɪn.dʒər/ (noun): someone moving to a new profession. The related verb phrase is "change careers".

items.question: Trong câu "When you join a project in an unfamiliar field, this route works:", từ "unfamiliar" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you join a project in an unfamiliar field, this route works:", what does "unfamiliar" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unfamiliar /ˌʌn.fəˈmɪl.i.ər/ (tính từ): lạ, chưa quen thuộc. "Unfamiliar with something" = chưa quen với điều gì; trái nghĩa: familiar.
items.explanationEn: unfamiliar /ˌʌn.fəˈmɪl.i.ər/ (adjective): not known or experienced before. "Unfamiliar with something" means not used to it; opposite: familiar.

items.question: Trong câu "Start a personal glossary on day one.", từ "glossary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Start a personal glossary on day one.", what does "glossary" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list of terms with meanings
items.explanation: glossary /ˈɡlɒs.ər.i/ (danh từ): bảng thuật ngữ. Glossary thường nằm cuối tài liệu yêu cầu, giải thích các thuật ngữ nghiệp vụ.
items.explanationEn: glossary /ˈɡlɒs.ər.i/ (noun): a list of terms with meanings. A glossary often sits at the end of a requirements document to define business terms.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not pretend to understand.", từ "pretend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not pretend to understand.", what does "pretend" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to act as if something is true
items.explanation: pretend /prɪˈtend/ (động từ): giả vờ. "Pretend to do something" = giả vờ làm gì; "pretend that…" = giả vờ rằng.
items.explanationEn: pretend /prɪˈtend/ (verb): to act as if something is true. "Pretend to do something" or "pretend that…" means to act falsely.

items.question: Trong câu "builds more credibility than nodding and guessing wrong.", từ "credibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "builds more credibility than nodding and guessing wrong.", what does "credibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credibility /ˌkred.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): uy tín, sự đáng tin. "Build/lose credibility" = tạo dựng/đánh mất uy tín.
items.explanationEn: credibility /ˌkred.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): the quality of being trusted. "Build/lose credibility" means to gain or lose trust.

items.question: Trong câu "builds more credibility than nodding and guessing wrong.", từ "nod" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "builds more credibility than nodding and guessing wrong.", what does "nod" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move the head down and up
items.explanation: nod /nɒd/ (động từ): gật đầu. Ở đây "nodding" chỉ việc gật gù như thể đã hiểu; "nod off" = ngủ gật.
items.explanationEn: nod /nɒd/ (verb): to move the head down and up. Here "nodding" means acting as if you understand; "nod off" means to fall asleep.

items.question: Trong câu "Draw the end-to-end process of the core business: where money and value travel, who participates at each step.", từ "end-to-end" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draw the end-to-end process of the core business: where money and value travel, who participates at each step.", what does "end-to-end" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: covering a process from start to finish
items.explanation: end-to-end /ˌend.tʊˈend/ (tính từ): từ đầu đến cuối. "End-to-end process/testing" = quy trình/kiểm thử trọn vẹn từ đầu tới cuối.
items.explanationEn: end-to-end /ˌend.tʊˈend/ (adjective): covering a process from start to finish. "End-to-end process/testing" covers the whole flow from start to finish.

items.question: Trong câu "Draw the end-to-end process of the core business: where money and value travel, who participates at each step.", từ "participate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draw the end-to-end process of the core business: where money and value travel, who participates at each step.", what does "participate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: participate /pɑːˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (động từ): tham gia. Đi với "in": "participate in a meeting" = tham gia cuộc họp; danh từ: participant.
items.explanationEn: participate /pɑːˈtɪs.ɪ.peɪt/ (verb): to take part. Used with "in": "participate in a meeting"; noun: participant.

items.question: Trong câu "Read the regulations and industry standards touching your area.", từ "regulation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read the regulations and industry standards touching your area.", what does "regulation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an official rule made by authorities
items.explanation: regulation /ˌreɡ.jəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy định pháp lý. "Comply with regulations" = tuân thủ quy định; ngân hàng, bảo hiểm có rất nhiều regulation.
items.explanationEn: regulation /ˌreɡ.jəˈleɪ.ʃən/ (noun): an official rule made by authorities. "Comply with regulations" means to follow them; banking and insurance have many.

items.question: Trong câu "Read the real data — run queries, see which values actually appear, look for exceptions.", từ "exception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read the real data — run queries, see which values actually appear, look for exceptions.", what does "exception" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a case that does not follow the rule
items.explanation: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): trường hợp ngoại lệ. "With the exception of" = ngoại trừ; trong lập trình còn có nghĩa "ngoại lệ" (lỗi được ném ra).
items.explanationEn: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): a case that does not follow the rule. "With the exception of" means except; in programming it also means a thrown error.

items.question: Trong câu "Read the support ticket repository — a ready-made list of real pain points.", từ "repository" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read the support ticket repository — a ready-made list of real pain points.", what does "repository" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a place where things are stored
items.explanation: repository /rɪˈpɒz.ɪ.tər.i/ (danh từ): kho lưu trữ. Dùng cho nơi chứa dữ liệu, tài liệu hoặc mã nguồn: "code repository", "document repository".
items.explanationEn: repository /rɪˈpɒz.ɪ.tər.i/ (noun): a place where things are stored. Used for stores of data, documents or code: "code repository", "document repository".

items.question: Trong câu "Read the support ticket repository — a ready-made list of real pain points.", từ "ready-made" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read the support ticket repository — a ready-made list of real pain points.", what does "ready-made" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ready-made /ˌred.iˈmeɪd/ (tính từ): có sẵn. "A ready-made solution" = giải pháp có sẵn, không phải tự xây.
items.explanationEn: ready-made /ˌred.iˈmeɪd/ (adjective): already prepared for use. "A ready-made solution" is one you do not have to build.

items.question: Trong câu "Read the support ticket repository — a ready-made list of real pain points.", từ "pain point" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Read the support ticket repository — a ready-made list of real pain points.", what does "pain point" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a sore spot on the body
items.explanation: pain point /ˈpeɪn ˌpɔɪnt/ (cụm từ): vấn đề gây khó chịu. Thuật ngữ phổ biến trong kinh doanh/UX: "customer pain points" = các vấn đề khách hàng gặp phải.
items.explanationEn: pain point /ˈpeɪn ˌpɔɪnt/ (phrase): a problem that frustrates users. Common in business and UX: "customer pain points" are problems customers face.

items.question: Trong câu "You will learn more than a week of reading process documentation, because you see the gap between the documented and the actual process.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You will learn more than a week of reading process documentation, because you see the gap between the documented and the actual process.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): sự chênh lệch. "Gap analysis" = phân tích khoảng cách giữa hiện trạng (as-is) và mong muốn (to-be).
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): a difference between two things. "Gap analysis" compares the current (as-is) and desired (to-be) states.

items.question: Trong câu "You predict the answer before asking, and are usually right.", từ "predict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You predict the answer before asking, and are usually right.", what does "predict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: predict /prɪˈdɪkt/ (động từ): dự đoán. Danh từ: prediction; "predictable" = có thể đoán trước.
items.explanationEn: predict /prɪˈdɪkt/ (verb): to say what will happen. Noun: prediction; "predictable" means able to be foreseen.

items.question: Trong câu "You notice when someone states the business incorrectly.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You notice when someone states the business incorrectly.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): phát biểu, nêu ra. Là động từ, "state" = nêu rõ; là danh từ nghĩa là "trạng thái" hoặc "bang".
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say something formally. As a verb it means to say clearly; as a noun it means a condition or a region.

items.question: Trong câu "Other certifications worth knowing: PMI-PBA (from PMI, business analysis within a project management context) and agile credentials such as CSPO for the Product Owner role.", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other certifications worth knowing: PMI-PBA (from PMI, business analysis within a project management context) and agile credentials such as CSPO for the Product Owner role.", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːθ/ (tính từ): đáng để. "Worth + V-ing": "worth knowing" = đáng biết; "worth it" = đáng công sức.
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːθ/ (adjective): deserving of an action. "Worth + -ing": "worth knowing"; "worth it" means deserving the effort.

items.question: Trong câu "Other certifications worth knowing: PMI-PBA (from PMI, business analysis within a project management context) and agile credentials such as CSPO for the Product Owner role.", từ "credential" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other certifications worth knowing: PMI-PBA (from PMI, business analysis within a project management context) and agile credentials such as CSPO for the Product Owner role.", what does "credential" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credential /krəˈden.ʃəl/ (danh từ): chứng chỉ, bằng cấp. Trong IT "credentials" còn là thông tin đăng nhập; ở đây là chứng chỉ nghề nghiệp.
items.explanationEn: credential /krəˈden.ʃəl/ (noun): a qualification proving ability. In IT "credentials" can mean login details; here it means professional qualifications.

items.question: Trong câu "The honest answer: it depends, and it matters less than many people think.", từ "it depends" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The honest answer: it depends, and it matters less than many people think.", what does "it depends" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: it depends /ɪt dɪˈpendz/ (cụm từ): còn tùy trường hợp. Câu trả lời an toàn khi phỏng vấn, nhưng nên nói tiếp "it depends on…" (tùy vào…).
items.explanationEn: it depends /ɪt dɪˈpendz/ (phrase): the answer varies by situation. A safe interview answer, best followed by "it depends on…".

items.question: Trong câu "You are changing careers and need a signal to employers that you are serious.", từ "signal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You are changing careers and need a signal to employers that you are serious.", what does "signal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (danh từ): dấu hiệu cho thấy. "Send a signal that…" = phát đi dấu hiệu rằng…; chứng chỉ là một signal cho nhà tuyển dụng.
items.explanationEn: signal /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/ (noun): something that shows an intention. "Send a signal that…" means to show something; a certificate signals seriousness.

items.question: Trong câu "You are changing careers and need a signal to employers that you are serious.", từ "employer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You are changing careers and need a signal to employers that you are serious.", what does "employer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person or company that hires
items.explanation: employer /ɪmˈplɔɪ.ər/ (danh từ): nhà tuyển dụng. Phân biệt: employer (người thuê) và employee (người được thuê).
items.explanationEn: employer /ɪmˈplɔɪ.ər/ (noun): a person or company that hires. Compare employer (who hires) with employee (who is hired).

items.question: Trong câu "A company or client explicitly requires them in a tender.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A company or client explicitly requires them in a tender.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng. Trái nghĩa: implicitly (ngầm); "explicitly state" = nêu rõ bằng lời.
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): in a clear, direct way. Opposite: implicitly; "explicitly state" means to say directly.

items.question: Trong câu "A company or client explicitly requires them in a tender.", từ "tender" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A company or client explicitly requires them in a tender.", what does "tender" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tender /ˈten.dər/ (danh từ): hồ sơ mời thầu. "Win a tender" = trúng thầu; "legal tender" lại có nghĩa là tiền tệ hợp pháp.
items.explanationEn: tender /ˈten.dər/ (noun): a formal request for bids. "Win a tender" means to win a bid; "legal tender" means official currency.

items.question: Trong câu "You want to systematise knowledge you acquired piecemeal through experience.", từ "systematise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You want to systematise knowledge you acquired piecemeal through experience.", what does "systematise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to arrange into an organised system
items.explanation: systematise /ˈsɪs.tə.mə.taɪz/ (động từ): hệ thống hóa. Cách viết Anh-Mỹ: systematize; nghĩa là sắp xếp kiến thức rời rạc thành hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: systematise /ˈsɪs.tə.mə.taɪz/ (verb): to arrange into an organised system. American spelling: systematize; it means turning scattered knowledge into a system.

items.question: Trong câu "You want to systematise knowledge you acquired piecemeal through experience.", từ "acquire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You want to systematise knowledge you acquired piecemeal through experience.", what does "acquire" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: acquire /əˈkwaɪər/ (động từ): tiếp thu, có được. "Acquire skills/knowledge" = tiếp thu kỹ năng/kiến thức; trong kinh doanh còn là "mua lại" công ty.
items.explanationEn: acquire /əˈkwaɪər/ (verb): to gain skills or knowledge. "Acquire skills/knowledge" means to gain them; in business it also means to buy a company.

items.question: Trong câu "You want to systematise knowledge you acquired piecemeal through experience.", từ "piecemeal" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You want to systematise knowledge you acquired piecemeal through experience.", what does "piecemeal" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: bit by bit, not all at once
items.explanation: piecemeal /ˈpiːs.miːl/ (trạng từ): từng phần rời rạc. Cũng dùng như tính từ: "a piecemeal approach" = cách làm chắp vá.
items.explanationEn: piecemeal /ˈpiːs.miːl/ (adverb): bit by bit, not all at once. Also an adjective: "a piecemeal approach" is an unplanned, patchy one.

items.question: Trong câu "You already have real experience and a clear portfolio — interviewers will ask about projects, not certificates.", từ "portfolio" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You already have real experience and a clear portfolio — interviewers will ask about projects, not certificates.", what does "portfolio" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: portfolio /pɔːtˈfəʊ.li.əʊ/ (danh từ): tập sản phẩm đã làm. Portfolio của BA gồm tài liệu phân tích, user story, sơ đồ quy trình đã tự làm.
items.explanationEn: portfolio /pɔːtˈfəʊ.li.əʊ/ (noun): a collection of work samples. A BA portfolio holds analysis documents, user stories and process diagrams you made.

items.question: Trong câu "You expect them to substitute for experience — they do not.", từ "substitute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You expect them to substitute for experience — they do not.", what does "substitute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: substitute /ˈsʌb.stɪ.tjuːt/ (động từ): thay thế cho. "Substitute for X" = thay cho X; "substitute A for B" = dùng A thay B.
items.explanationEn: substitute /ˈsʌb.stɪ.tjuːt/ (verb): to take the place of. "Substitute for X" means replace X; "substitute A for B" means use A instead of B.

items.question: Trong câu "A blunt assessment: in most markets, a project you built yourself and can discuss for twenty minutes is worth more than a certificate.", từ "blunt" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A blunt assessment: in most markets, a project you built yourself and can discuss for twenty minutes is worth more than a certificate.", what does "blunt" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: blunt /blʌnt/ (tính từ): thẳng thắn, thẳng thừng. "To be blunt" = nói thẳng ra; nghĩa gốc là "cùn" (dao cùn).
items.explanationEn: blunt /blʌnt/ (adjective): direct, without softening words. "To be blunt" means to speak plainly; the basic sense is "not sharp".

items.question: Trong câu "A certificate proves you studied; a portfolio proves you can do the work.", từ "prove" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A certificate proves you studied; a portfolio proves you can do the work.", what does "prove" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prove /pruːv/ (động từ): chứng minh. Danh từ: proof (bằng chứng); "prove yourself" = chứng tỏ năng lực bản thân.
items.explanationEn: prove /pruːv/ (verb): to show something is true. Noun: proof; "prove yourself" means to show your ability.

items.question: Trong câu "Employers assess four things, in this order of importance:", từ "assess" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Employers assess four things, in this order of importance:", what does "assess" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assess /əˈses/ (động từ): đánh giá. Danh từ: assessment; "assess impact/risk" = đánh giá tác động/rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: assess /əˈses/ (verb): to judge the quality of. Noun: assessment; "assess impact/risk" is a common collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "How do you approach an ambiguous problem?", từ "approach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How do you approach an ambiguous problem?", what does "approach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (động từ): tiếp cận, xử lý. "Approach a problem" = cách bắt tay giải quyết vấn đề; nghĩa gốc là "đến gần".
items.explanationEn: approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/ (verb): to start dealing with. "Approach a problem" means to start tackling it; the basic sense is to come near.

items.question: Trong câu "How do you approach an ambiguous problem?", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How do you approach an ambiguous problem?", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: open to more than one meaning
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. Yêu cầu tốt phải "unambiguous" (không mơ hồ, chỉ hiểu được một cách).
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (adjective): open to more than one meaning. Good requirements must be "unambiguous", with only one possible reading.

items.question: Trong câu "Do you explain something complex clearly?", từ "complex" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do you explain something complex clearly?", what does "complex" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: complex /ˈkɒm.pleks/ (tính từ): phức tạp. Là danh từ, "complex" = khu phức hợp (a sports complex).
items.explanationEn: complex /ˈkɒm.pleks/ (adjective): having many connected parts. As a noun, "complex" means a group of buildings (a sports complex).

items.question: Trong câu "A key point: newcomers usually prepare items 3 and 4 but get rejected on 1 and 2.", từ "newcomer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A key point: newcomers usually prepare items 3 and 4 but get rejected on 1 and 2.", what does "newcomer" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who has recently arrived
items.explanation: newcomer /ˈnjuːˌkʌm.ər/ (danh từ): người mới vào. "A newcomer to the field" = người mới vào ngành.
items.explanationEn: newcomer /ˈnjuːˌkʌm.ər/ (noun): a person who has recently arrived. "A newcomer to the field" is someone new to an industry.

items.question: Trong câu "A key point: newcomers usually prepare items 3 and 4 but get rejected on 1 and 2.", từ "reject" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A key point: newcomers usually prepare items 3 and 4 but get rejected on 1 and 2.", what does "reject" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (động từ): loại, từ chối. "Get rejected" = bị loại; danh từ: rejection.
items.explanationEn: reject /rɪˈdʒekt/ (verb): to refuse to accept. "Get rejected" means to be turned down; noun: rejection.

items.question: Trong câu "You can memorise BABOK definitions and still fail if you cannot demonstrate how you think.", từ "memorise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can memorise BABOK definitions and still fail if you cannot demonstrate how you think.", what does "memorise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: memorise /ˈmem.ə.raɪz/ (động từ): học thuộc lòng. Cách viết Mỹ: memorize; học thuộc định nghĩa không thay được tư duy.
items.explanationEn: memorise /ˈmem.ə.raɪz/ (verb): to learn by heart. American spelling: memorize; memorising definitions does not replace thinking.

items.question: Trong câu "You can memorise BABOK definitions and still fail if you cannot demonstrate how you think.", từ "demonstrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can memorise BABOK definitions and still fail if you cannot demonstrate how you think.", what does "demonstrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: demonstrate /ˈdem.ən.streɪt/ (động từ): thể hiện, chứng tỏ. "Demonstrate skills" = thể hiện kỹ năng; "demo" là dạng rút gọn (buổi trình diễn).
items.explanationEn: demonstrate /ˈdem.ən.streɪt/ (verb): to show clearly. "Demonstrate skills" means to show them; "demo" is the short form.

items.question: Trong câu "Durable reasons: enjoying understanding problems, enjoying connecting people.", từ "durable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Durable reasons: enjoying understanding problems, enjoying connecting people.", what does "durable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (tính từ): lâu bền, bền vững. Dùng cho vật ("durable goods" = hàng lâu bền) và cả động lực, lý do lâu dài.
items.explanationEn: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (adjective): lasting a long time. Used for goods ("durable goods") and for long-lasting motives or reasons.

items.question: Trong câu "The four groups: elicit, analyse and model, specify, stay to completion", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four groups: elicit, analyse and model, specify, stay to completion", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thu thập. "Elicit requirements" = khai thác yêu cầu từ các bên liên quan; đừng nhầm với "illicit" (bất hợp pháp).
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. "Elicit requirements" means drawing them out of stakeholders; do not confuse with "illicit".

items.question: Trong câu "The four groups: elicit, analyse and model, specify, stay to completion", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four groups: elicit, analyse and model, specify, stay to completion", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): đặc tả, nêu cụ thể. Danh từ: specification (đặc tả, thường viết tắt "spec").
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to state exactly in detail. Noun: specification, often shortened to "spec".

items.question: Trong câu "The four groups: elicit, analyse and model, specify, stay to completion", từ "completion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four groups: elicit, analyse and model, specify, stay to completion", what does "completion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: completion /kəmˈpliː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự hoàn thành. "Stay to completion" = theo đến khi xong; "completion date" = ngày hoàn thành.
items.explanationEn: completion /kəmˈpliː.ʃən/ (noun): the act of finishing. "Stay to completion" means to see it through; "completion date" is the finish date.

items.question: Trong câu "All three parts, especially the so that clause stating value; plus acceptance criteria covering a failure case", từ "clause" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All three parts, especially the so that clause stating value; plus acceptance criteria covering a failure case", what does "clause" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a part of a sentence with a verb
items.explanation: clause /klɔːz/ (danh từ): mệnh đề (câu). Trong user story, "so that clause" là mệnh đề nêu giá trị; trong hợp đồng "clause" là điều khoản.
items.explanationEn: clause /klɔːz/ (noun): a part of a sentence with a verb. In a user story the "so that" clause states value; in a contract a clause is a term.

items.question: Trong câu "All three parts, especially the so that clause stating value; plus acceptance criteria covering a failure case", từ "criterion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All three parts, especially the so that clause stating value; plus acceptance criteria covering a failure case", what does "criterion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. Số nhiều bất quy tắc: criteria; "acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: criterion /kraɪˈtɪə.ri.ən/ (noun): a standard used for judging. Irregular plural: criteria; "acceptance criteria" define when a story is done.

items.question: Trong câu "Verifiable, unambiguous, covers exceptions, and a tester can write test cases from it", từ "verifiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Verifiable, unambiguous, covers exceptions, and a tester can write test cases from it", what does "verifiable" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: able to be checked as true
items.explanation: verifiable /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể kiểm chứng. Động từ: verify; yêu cầu verifiable là yêu cầu kiểm thử được.
items.explanationEn: verifiable /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ.ə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be checked as true. Verb: verify; a verifiable requirement is one you can test.

items.question: Trong câu "Name several AND state which technique suits which situation", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Name several AND state which technique suits which situation", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. Tính từ: suitable; là danh từ "suit" = bộ com-lê.
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. Adjective: suitable; as a noun "suit" is a set of formal clothes.

items.question: Trong câu "The principle for situational answers: always show that you CLARIFY and SUPPLY DATA, while the DECISION belongs to whoever has authority.", từ "situational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle for situational answers: always show that you CLARIFY and SUPPLY DATA, while the DECISION belongs to whoever has authority.", what does "situational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: situational /ˌsɪtʃ.uˈeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): theo tình huống. "Situational questions" = câu hỏi tình huống trong phỏng vấn ("What would you do if…").
items.explanationEn: situational /ˌsɪtʃ.uˈeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): based on a particular situation. "Situational questions" ask what you would do in a given case.

items.question: Trong câu "The principle for situational answers: always show that you CLARIFY and SUPPLY DATA, while the DECISION belongs to whoever has authority.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle for situational answers: always show that you CLARIFY and SUPPLY DATA, while the DECISION belongs to whoever has authority.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): thẩm quyền. "Have the authority to decide" = có thẩm quyền quyết định; "the authorities" = nhà chức trách.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the power to make decisions. "Have the authority to decide" means having the power; "the authorities" are officials.

items.question: Trong câu "The principle for situational answers: always show that you CLARIFY and SUPPLY DATA, while the DECISION belongs to whoever has authority.", từ "supply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle for situational answers: always show that you CLARIFY and SUPPLY DATA, while the DECISION belongs to whoever has authority.", what does "supply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (động từ): cung cấp. "Supply data/information" = cung cấp dữ liệu; danh từ "supply" = nguồn cung.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (verb): to provide something needed. "Supply data/information" means to provide it; the noun means a stock available.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask why repeatedly to find the real need; if you still differ, present the trade-off and let them decide", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask why repeatedly to find the real need; if you still differ, present the trade-off and let them decide", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Present the trade-off" = trình bày cái được và cái mất của mỗi phương án.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance between two options. "Present the trade-off" means showing what each option gains and loses.

items.question: Trong câu "Ask why repeatedly to find the real need; if you still differ, present the trade-off and let them decide", từ "repeatedly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ask why repeatedly to find the real need; if you still differ, present the trade-off and let them decide", what does "repeatedly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.tɪd.li/ (trạng từ): nhiều lần liên tiếp. Kỹ thuật "5 Whys" = hỏi "tại sao" nhiều lần để tìm nguyên nhân gốc.
items.explanationEn: repeatedly /rɪˈpiː.tɪd.li/ (adverb): again and again. The "5 Whys" technique asks "why" repeatedly to find the root cause.

items.question: Trong câu "Clarify with examples and models; if it is a priority conflict, take the data to whoever has authority", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clarify with examples and models; if it is a priority conflict, take the data to whoever has authority", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. Danh từ: clarification; "could you clarify…?" là câu hỏi lịch sự khi họp.
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make clear. Noun: clarification; "could you clarify…?" is a polite meeting question.

items.question: Trong câu "Clarify with examples and models; if it is a priority conflict, take the data to whoever has authority", từ "conflict" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clarify with examples and models; if it is a priority conflict, take the data to whoever has authority", what does "conflict" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a clash between needs or ideas
items.explanation: conflict /ˈkɒn.flɪkt/ (danh từ): sự xung đột. "Priority conflict" = xung đột ưu tiên; "resolve a conflict" = giải quyết xung đột.
items.explanationEn: conflict /ˈkɒn.flɪkt/ (noun): a clash between needs or ideas. "Priority conflict" is a clash of priorities; "resolve a conflict" is a key collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "Assess impact, present the trade-off, let the authority decide — never quietly hide it", từ "impact" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assess impact, present the trade-off, let the authority decide — never quietly hide it", what does "impact" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (danh từ): tác động, ảnh hưởng. "Impact analysis" = phân tích tác động của một thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: impact /ˈɪm.pækt/ (noun): the effect something has. "Impact analysis" studies the effect of a change.

items.question: Trong câu "are usually marked down for not understanding role boundaries.", từ "mark down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "are usually marked down for not understanding role boundaries.", what does "mark down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mark down /ˌmɑːk ˈdaʊn/ (cụm từ): trừ điểm, đánh giá thấp. "Be marked down for X" = bị trừ điểm vì X; trong bán lẻ "mark down" = hạ giá.
items.explanationEn: mark down /ˌmɑːk ˈdaʊn/ (phrase): to give a lower score. "Be marked down for X" means losing points for X; in retail it means cutting prices.

items.question: Trong câu "are usually marked down for not understanding role boundaries.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "are usually marked down for not understanding role boundaries.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a limit of an area or role
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới, giới hạn. "Role boundaries" = giới hạn trách nhiệm của vai trò; "set boundaries" = đặt giới hạn.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a limit of an area or role. "Role boundaries" are the limits of a role; "set boundaries" means to set limits.

items.question: Trong câu "Pick a real application you use daily — a food delivery app, an e-wallet, a marketplace.", từ "marketplace" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick a real application you use daily — a food delivery app, an e-wallet, a marketplace.", what does "marketplace" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an online platform for buying and selling
items.explanation: marketplace /ˈmɑː.kɪt.pleɪs/ (danh từ): sàn thương mại. Ví dụ các sàn như Shopee, Tiki là "online marketplace".
items.explanationEn: marketplace /ˈmɑː.kɪt.pleɪs/ (noun): an online platform for buying and selling. Platforms connecting many sellers and buyers are "online marketplaces".

items.question: Trong câu "Identify user classes and stakeholders.", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Identify user classes and stakeholders.", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person affected by a project
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. "Stakeholder analysis" = phân tích các bên liên quan và mức ảnh hưởng của họ.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkˌhəʊl.dər/ (noun): a person affected by a project. "Stakeholder analysis" identifies affected parties and their influence.

items.question: Trong câu "Chart the main business process with a flowchart or BPMN.", từ "chart" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chart the main business process with a flowchart or BPMN.", what does "chart" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: chart /tʃɑːt/ (động từ): vẽ sơ đồ. Là danh từ "chart" = biểu đồ; "chart a course" = vạch lộ trình.
items.explanationEn: chart /tʃɑːt/ (verb): to draw as a diagram. As a noun it means a diagram; "chart a course" means to plan a route.

items.question: Trong câu "List the business rules you can infer from the app's behaviour.", từ "infer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "List the business rules you can infer from the app's behaviour.", what does "infer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: infer /ɪnˈfɜːr/ (động từ): suy ra. "Infer X from Y" = suy ra X từ Y; đừng nhầm với "imply" (ám chỉ).
items.explanationEn: infer /ɪnˈfɜːr/ (verb): to conclude from evidence. "Infer X from Y" means to conclude X from Y; do not confuse with "imply".

items.question: Trong câu "Wireframe one feature you would improve, with your reasoning.", từ "reasoning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wireframe one feature you would improve, with your reasoning.", what does "reasoning" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reasoning /ˈriː.zən.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): lập luận. Nhà tuyển dụng quan tâm "your reasoning" = cách bạn suy luận ra quyết định.
items.explanationEn: reasoning /ˈriː.zən.ɪŋ/ (noun): the logic behind a decision. Interviewers care about "your reasoning", the logic behind your choices.

items.question: Trong câu "Pick one real problem in that application and propose a solution with a trade-off analysis.", từ "propose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick one real problem in that application and propose a solution with a trade-off analysis.", what does "propose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (động từ): đề xuất. Danh từ: proposal (bản đề xuất); "propose a solution" = đề xuất giải pháp.
items.explanationEn: propose /prəˈpəʊz/ (verb): to suggest a plan. Noun: proposal; "propose a solution" is a common collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "The biggest differentiator in a fresher interview is not a certificate but something you built yourself and can discuss for twenty minutes.", từ "differentiator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The biggest differentiator in a fresher interview is not a certificate but something you built yourself and can discuss for twenty minutes.", what does "differentiator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a factor that sets you apart
items.explanation: differentiator /ˌdɪf.əˈren.ʃi.eɪ.tər/ (danh từ): yếu tố tạo khác biệt. Động từ: differentiate (phân biệt, tạo khác biệt); "key differentiator" = điểm khác biệt chính.
items.explanationEn: differentiator /ˌdɪf.əˈren.ʃi.eɪ.tər/ (noun): a factor that sets you apart. Verb: differentiate; "key differentiator" is the main thing that sets you apart.

items.question: Trong câu "It proves you can do the work, not merely that you studied the theory.", từ "merely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It proves you can do the work, not merely that you studied the theory.", what does "merely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (trạng từ): chỉ, đơn thuần. "Not merely X but Y" = không chỉ X mà còn Y.
items.explanationEn: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (adverb): only, simply. "Not merely X but Y" means not only X but also Y.

items.question: Trong câu "An internal project at your current job — if you work in accounting or operations, volunteer for your department's digitisation project.", từ "volunteer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An internal project at your current job — if you work in accounting or operations, volunteer for your department's digitisation project.", what does "volunteer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: volunteer /ˌvɒl.ənˈtɪər/ (động từ): xung phong, tình nguyện. "Volunteer for a project" = xung phong nhận dự án; danh từ cùng dạng: a volunteer.
items.explanationEn: volunteer /ˌvɒl.ənˈtɪər/ (verb): to offer to do something. "Volunteer for a project" means to offer to join; the noun is also "volunteer".

items.question: Trong câu "An internship or volunteer project for a nonprofit.", từ "internship" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An internship or volunteer project for a nonprofit.", what does "internship" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: internship /ˈɪn.tɜːn.ʃɪp/ (danh từ): kỳ thực tập. "Do an internship" = đi thực tập; người thực tập là "intern".
items.explanationEn: internship /ˈɪn.tɜːn.ʃɪp/ (noun): a period of work training. "Do an internship" means to train at a company; the person is an "intern".

items.question: Trong câu "Domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach and raises your value fastest — learn it methodically rather than by osmosis.", từ "methodically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach and raises your value fastest — learn it methodically rather than by osmosis.", what does "methodically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: methodically /məˈθɒd.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): có phương pháp. Tính từ: methodical; học methodically = có lộ trình, có hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: methodically /məˈθɒd.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): in an orderly, planned way. Adjective: methodical; learning methodically means following a plan.

items.question: Trong câu "Domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach and raises your value fastest — learn it methodically rather than by osmosis.", từ "osmosis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Domain knowledge is the hardest thing to teach and raises your value fastest — learn it methodically rather than by osmosis.", what does "osmosis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: osmosis /ɒzˈməʊ.sɪs/ (danh từ): sự thấm dần tự nhiên. "Learn by osmosis" = học lỏm, thấm dần qua môi trường mà không học chủ động.
items.explanationEn: osmosis /ɒzˈməʊ.sɪs/ (noun): gradual, unconscious absorbing. "Learn by osmosis" means picking things up passively from your surroundings.

items.question: Trong câu "Certifications are a signal, not a capability — most useful when changing careers or when a client requires one.", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Certifications are a signal, not a capability — most useful when changing careers or when a client requires one.", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the actual ability to do something
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực thực sự. Tính từ: capable; "capable of doing X" = có khả năng làm X.
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): the actual ability to do something. Adjective: capable; "capable of doing X" means able to do X.

items.question: Trong câu "A self-created portfolio is the most practical route to demonstrating capability before you have real project experience.", từ "practical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A self-created portfolio is the most practical route to demonstrating capability before you have real project experience.", what does "practical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: practical /ˈpræk.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): thiết thực, khả thi. Trái nghĩa: theoretical; "practical experience" = kinh nghiệm thực tế.
items.explanationEn: practical /ˈpræk.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): useful and realistic. Opposite: theoretical; "practical experience" means hands-on experience.

items.question: Trong câu "Three signs of sufficient domain knowledge: predicting answers correctly, noticing errors, being asked for opinions beyond the software.", từ "sufficient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three signs of sufficient domain knowledge: predicting answers correctly, noticing errors, being asked for opinions beyond the software.", what does "sufficient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (tính từ): đủ, đầy đủ. Trái nghĩa: insufficient; "sufficient for X" = đủ cho X.
items.explanationEn: sufficient /səˈfɪʃ.ənt/ (adjective): enough for a purpose. Opposite: insufficient; "sufficient for X" means enough for X.
